item.title: On Smyrna Road & Gascony Avenue corner, 27th November
item.description:
There is daily flytipping in this location which I report via love clean streets which has occurred for years and is a significant problem. I believe there was a sign for no flytipping which has been taken down as there are visible marks which show where one was which would drastically reduce the amount of flytipping and ultimately save the council money as less attendances from love clean streets would be required. I have attached an example of one shown opposite in another location and would like to request reinstallation of a sign but higher so it cannot be removed.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 10-11, Smyrna Road, Kilburn, Greater London
